facts.statement: Take Furosemide 40 mg twice a day at 8 am and 2 pm, which is an increase from 20 mg daily.
facts.label: Furosemide 40 mg: twice a day, 8 am and 2 pm

facts.statement: Start taking a new medicine, Spironolactone 25 mg daily.
facts.label: Spironolactone 25 mg: daily

facts.statement: Stop taking ibuprofen and use paracetamol 500 mg up to 3 times a day only when needed instead.
facts.label: Stop ibuprofen; paracetamol 500 mg if needed

facts.statement: Weigh yourself every morning and call the heart failure nurse line if your weight increases more than 2 kg in 3 days.
facts.label: Weigh daily: call if up 2 kg in 3 days

facts.statement: Limit fluids to 1.5 L per day and keep salt under 2 g sodium per day.
facts.label: Fluids 1.5 L, salt 2 g

facts.statement: Call 112 immediately if you have shortness of breath at rest, chest pain, or fainting.
facts.label: Call 112: breathless at rest, chest pain, fainting

facts.statement: Call the heart failure nurse line the same day if you have new ankle swelling, need more pillows to sleep, or feel dizzy when standing.
facts.label: Nurse line: swelling, pillows, dizzy

facts.statement: Have a blood test at the outpatient lab on 22 Oct 2026.
facts.label: Blood test: 22 Oct 2026, outpatient lab

facts.statement: Attend the heart failure clinic with Dr. Elena Bianchi on 12 Nov 2026 at 10:30.
facts.label: Heart failure clinic: 12 Nov 2026

facts.statement: Walk 10-15 min twice a day as tolerated and do not lift anything over 5 kg for 2 weeks.
facts.label: Walk 10-15 min, lift <5 kg
